pages.lesson:
LESSON: EXTENSIVE READING: LIBRARY SKILLS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ARABIC LANGUAGE
Strand: Reading 2.7 Reading Comprehension (2 sessions) • Vocabulary building-parts of th
Topic 2.9: Extensive Reading: Library Skills

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Extensive Reading: Library Skills. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How can we make reading texts enjoyable?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify simple Arabic texts to read for enjoyment

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify simple Arabic texts to read for enjoyment
   In simple words: practise until you can identify simple Arabic texts to read for enjoyment. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Extensive Reading: Library Skills using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Extensive Reading: Library Skills in the examples.
2. Explain Extensive Reading: Library Skills to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Extensive Reading: Library Skills.
4. Show that you can: identify simple Arabic texts to read for enjoyment

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Extensive Reading: Library Skills using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Extensive Reading: Library Skills important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Team up to identify simple texts to read for enjoyment,
2. Conduct a reader’s theatre to read Arabic texts with peers,
3. Citizenship: This is promoted as the learner accumulates information on various themes when participating in book club sessions to discuss Arabic stories read.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify simple Arabic texts to read for enjoyment

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
